Equipping the Parrot Egg in the trinket slot causes a parrot to spawn and follow the player around. The parrot causes

to occasionally drop gold coins when slain. Each gold coin is worth 250g. The chance for enemies to drop coins (Y) depends on the parrot's level (X), which ranges from 1 to 4. When the Parrot Egg is dropped, its level ranges from 1 to 4, with a limit depending on the player's total earnings. Each possible level is equally likely once the player has passed the earnings threshold (e.g., there is a 50% chance to get a level 2 parrot if the player has earned between 750,000g and 1,500,000g).
